title: Change permissions recursively for a directory
summary: Apply permission changes to all files and subdirectories inside a folder. Useful for fixing permissions on a downloaded project.

steps.explain: Recursively add read permission for all users, and execute permission for directories and files that already have it. This is safer than blindly adding execute to everything.

warnings: Changing permissions recursively can affect many files. Ensure you are targeting the correct directory.

rollback.explain: There is no automatic undo for chmod. You must manually reset permissions to their previous state if needed.
